decision_rationale: This is an assessment/benchmarking paper comparing pretraining for DNA sequence models, not a primary text-bio model. The evidence shows only genomic sequences with BPE/MLM tokenization, with no natural-language text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “An Assessment of Pre-Training for Fine-Tuning Tasks”; “we investigate three key questions” about “pretraining” and “BPE tokenization” on genomics-related tasks; “masked language modeling (MLM) objective” on DNA sequences
